capabilities: Record voice from a mic button in a note
Transcribe recordings with OpenAI, Groq, Deepgram or AssemblyAI
Apply custom AI prompts to transcriptions
Embed audio playback and AI output as callouts
Save recordings to a folder before transcription
extras: Billing information is required on the provider account to make API calls; failed transcriptions can be retried with the 'Transcribe audio file' command.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to record voice, transcribe it through an STT provider, and process the result with custom AI prompts inside a note.
